name: Tomato Sauce
ingredients: Concentrated Tomatoes (Contains 126g of Tomatoes per 100g or 19g of Tomatoes per 15g serve), Sugar, Salt, Food Acid (Acetic Acid), Spices, Natural Flavours. Contains 81% Concentrated Tomatoes.
storage: TRANSFER PRODUCT INTO A CLEAN AND DRY NON-METALLIC CONTAINER AND KEEP REFRIGERATED.
origin: MADE IN NEW ZEALAND FROM IMPORTED AND LOCAL INGREDIENTS
note: Servings per package printed 'Approx. 38' at 15 g. No net weight is printed on either photographed face, so pack is unrecorded rather than inferred from 38 x 15. The '126g of Tomatoes per 100g' and '81%' figures were re-read from a native-resolution crop. Barcode wraps round the can: only '…400547 00739…' is legible, missing both the leading digit and the check digit, so no gtin is recorded. No allergen statement on the panel. 'PX23993/J' beside the barcode is a batch code. GTIN and net weight read from Heinz Wattie's own NZ product page 2026-09-06, NOT from the photograph. The record carried no pack size, so the usual four-way match could not be run; the SKU was pinned two other ways instead, each stronger than a size match. (1) The barcode fragment above, '…400547 00739…', is a substring of 9400547007394, the EAN-13 the maker's page carries for the 575 g, and is NOT a substring of the 560 g EAN (9300657240424); an EAN-13 admits only one check digit, so once the eleven legible digits are fixed there is one candidate, not several. The 565 g and 1.1 kg SKUs' barcodes were not checked, so this rests on (2) as much as on (1). (2) That page's ingredient text is byte-for-byte the line transcribed from this can, including the unusual '126g of Tomatoes per 100g', '19g per 15g serve' and '81%' figures, which differ from the 330 g and 50%-less-sugar recipes. 38 x 15 g = 570 g agrees with a 575 g net. ALLERGENS ARE STILL OPEN: neither the manufacturer's page nor the Woolworths NZ listing publishes any allergen statement for this product, and no statement is not the same as no allergen.
